object_description: compact overall facility gathering all programme parts under one roof as an island in the landscape
geometry_property: terraced house structure for the classrooms
roof extensions and large bay windows
design_condition: the facility is positioned as an island on the edge of the large landscape chamber, its distance and height reference chosen so that the views into the landscape are preserved and the sweep of the slope can be experienced again

positive: The site-specific positioning as an island on the edge of the landscape chamber is precise and convincing
Distance and height reference to the historic ensemble preserve the views into the landscape
Not replacing the gymnasium in its existing location lets the sweep of the site towards the opposite slope be experienced again
This decision to clean up the landscape situation brings a great deal of reassurance and conviction
School operations are reorganised in a triangular relationship and the end of the slope is spatially defined
The three programme sections are designed as a compact overall facility under one roof
The very different uses are integrated into this large form and appear outside as a self-evident unit
A new promenade integrates the complex into the network of paths of the overall complex and the village
The landscaping connects the islands of the three school areas with spacious, freely configurable play areas
The all-weather area behind the gymnasium is well located in combination with the playground
The castle courtyard is tidied up in a natural way and the parking is rearranged
The terraced house structure gives the classes a recognisable identity, also volumetrically from outside
Inside, the identity is reflected in the sequence from entrance through group room and classroom to individual garden
The orientation of the classrooms towards the south is good
The two-storey room, gallery and east-facing skylight create an interesting sequence of rooms
The rough-sawn silver fir cladding and large-format glazing correspond to the scale and structure the skin adequately
Lighting conditions in the halls are good thanks to windows on two sides
The structural design is careful and the structural concept is clear and easy to implement
The connection to the existing ensemble is unobtrusive yet appealing
The entrance area with the all-weather square is a welcome social meeting point
The outdoor classrooms are easy to use thanks to their placement and demarcation
A sensitive approach to the landscape and to the needs of the children across the whole perimeter
One building on two storeys results in a fairly compact project achieving the grey energy and daylight targets
A relatively large floor area in a compact volume gives average cost-effectiveness
The definition as a compact whole establishes an appropriate dialogue with the historic complex without competing with it
negative: The shared entrance for gymnasium and primary school is seen as problematic
The primary school lacks a shared entrance space identifying it as an ensemble
The over-instrumented northern corridor cannot sufficiently cover this function
The intervention in the slope with high retaining walls is not mature enough
The terraced house structure is unsuitable for a basic classroom due to lack of flexibility and independence
The enclosed group rooms cannot be used independently and lack an appropriate connection to the outside
A view from the hall level into the landscape would have been desirable
Arranging the outdoor spaces to the south requires a relatively deep encroachment into the landscape
Whether object play works in a castle garden remains to be seen
The parking is only separated from the entrance by a narrow hedge, unsatisfactory for address formation
The all-weather square location is compensated by an unsightly cut into the topography
Solar gains are limited by north orientation and fixed shading
The untreated timber facade is only partially protected from the weather
The bulkhead structure of the basic level restricts the flexibility of use
The internal organisation of the basic level has conceptual shortcomings precluding the desired flexibility
